verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs explicitly describe Git integration generating a preview URL per branch/pull request, environment variable management across preview/production/custom environments, and preview access controls, comment collaboration, and CMS draft preview on those environments — collectively delivering ephemeral full-stack preview environments per PR. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically calling out PR-level ephemerality (docs and community evidence corroborate the general deploy workflow but not a dedicated third-party walkthrough of the PR preview lifecycle).
